metadata.article_title: Person falsely contracting as agent not entitled to performance.

article.title: Person falsely contracting as agent not entitled to performance.
article.content: A person with whom a contract has been entered into in the character of agent, is not entitled to require the performance of it, if he was in reality acting, not as agent, but on his own account.
article.html:
236Person falsely contracting as agent not entitled to performance.

Section 236 · Chapter X · Effect of agency on contracts with third persons · page 51 of the Act

A person with whom a contract has been entered into in the character of agent, is not entitled to require the performance of it, if he was in reality acting, not as agent, but on his own account.
